biography: John Fenning, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and exasperation in British racing circles, hails from a small village nestled in the Cotswolds. His journey began not on a pristine track, but on muddy country lanes, tearing around in his grandfather's beat-up Austin Mini. It was here, dodging sheep and mastering treacherous bends, that Fenning honed his raw talent. He quickly made a name for himself in local rallycross events, known for his fearless (some would say reckless) driving. A defining moment came at the Brands Hatch Mini Festival in 2012. Starting near the back due to a qualifying mishap, Fenning carved his way through the field, pulling off daring overtakes that had the crowd on their feet. A mechanical failure robbed him of victory in the final lap, but the performance had caught the eye of a small MINI Cooper S team. Now a veteran, Fenning continues to compete, chasing that elusive championship while battling his own inconsistency and the demons of past mistakes. Though his talent is undeniable, his current form is a pale shadow of his former glory, leaving many to wonder if his best days are behind him. He is known for his aggressive driving style and is a fan favorite despite not always finishing. He now races in a privateer MINI Cooper S team, struggling with funding and finding the right setup.
drivingStyle: Fenning's driving style can be described as 'controlled chaos'. He's renowned for his late braking and aggressive corner entries, often pushing his car to the absolute limit. Tire management isn't his strongest suit; he tends to burn through rubber quickly, prioritizing raw speed over long-term strategy. Under pressure, he can either rise to the occasion with a stunning performance or crack completely, making unpredictable errors. His inconsistency is frustrating for his team, but thrilling for the spectators.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision in the 2018 Silverstone race where Thorne accused Fenning of deliberately taking him out.
A fierce on-track rivalry fueled by numerous close calls and near-misses. Fenning and Rossi have a history of trading paint and aggressive overtakes.
Benson, a meticulous engineer, has openly criticized Fenning's seat-of-the-pants approach, leading to a clash of personalities and a mutual lack of respect.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks (unwashed) for every race.
Refuses to look at any timing data before the race, preferring to rely on 'gut feeling'.
Has a pre-race ritual of listening to a specific heavy metal song at maximum volume.
famousQuote: "Sometimes you gotta send it, even if you don't know where you're going."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2015 Oulton Park Gold Cup after a thrilling last-lap overtake. It was a moment of pure brilliance, showcasing Fenning's raw talent and unwavering determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2019 Donington Park race, costing him a potential championship victory. The incident was attributed to driver error and led to a period of intense self-doubt.
